title: Seizing the AI opportunity
description: Meeting the demands of the Intelligence Age will require strategic investment in energy and infrastructure. OpenAI’s submission to the White House details how expanding capacity and workforce readiness can sustain U.S. leadership in AI and economic growth.
author: Desconocido

title: Strengthening ChatGPT’s responses in sensitive conversations
description: OpenAI collaborated with 170+ mental health experts to improve ChatGPT’s ability to recognize distress, respond empathetically, and guide users toward real-world support—reducing unsafe responses by up to 80%. Learn how we’re making ChatGPT safer and more supportive in sensitive moments.
author: Desconocido

title: Addendum to GPT-5 System Card: Sensitive conversations
description: This system card details GPT-5’s improvements in handling sensitive conversations, including new benchmarks for emotional reliance, mental health, and jailbreak resistance.
author: Desconocido

title: A law and tax firm redefines efficiency with ChatGPT Business
description: Learn how Steuerrecht.com uses ChatGPT Business to streamline legal workflows, automate tax research, and scale client service—helping law firms boost productivity and stay competitive.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI acquires Software Applications Incorporated, maker of Sky
description: OpenAI has acquired Software Applications Incorporated, maker of Sky—a natural language interface for Mac that brings AI directly into your desktop experience. Together, we’re integrating Sky’s deep macOS capabilities into ChatGPT to make AI more intuitive, contextual, and action-oriented.
author: Desconocido

title: Consensus accelerates research with GPT-5 and Responses API
description: Consensus uses GPT-5 and OpenAI’s Responses API to power a multi-agent research assistant that reads, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence in minutes—helping over 8 million researchers accelerate scientific discovery.
author: Desconocido
